releases.notes: ## The Dimensions Update!! **Changes:** * Update to [Surveyor 1.1](https://modrinth.com/mod/surveyor/version/1.1.0+1.20) - supporting cross-dimensional client side mapping. * Allow viewing other dimensions by pressing `[TAB]` or clicking the new vertical bookmarks. * Bookmarks have custom icons via `namespace/textures/atlas/dimension/path.png` and color/name via mcmeta. * Dimension order and relative scale can be tweaked through the config. * Add a small `...` indicator in the bottom right of the atlas screen when tiles are loading. * Include stack components with placed markers so they look better for [Hoofprint](https://modrinth.com/mod/hoofprint) players. (vice versa later) * Correct bookmarks to use base / entity dye colors again - old markers will need colors reset. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/compare/v3.0.0+1.20...v3.1.0+1.20

releases.notes:
## Antique Atlas 3.0!

**Major Changes**:
* Update to [Surveyor 1.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/surveyor/version/1.0.0+1.20) - with major improvements to mod compatibility, memory use, and map sharing.
* Allow editing existing map markers by right clicking them.
* Add `emptyHandling` option that allows unexplored chunks to appear as cloud tiles.
* Hold ALT to see the debug / tile information at any time.
* Add nether biomes by @lumiscosity in ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/264))
* Fix atlas rendering with shaders by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/332))
* Badlands, dripstone caves and lush caves tiles + image compression by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/228))

**Minor Changes**:
* Marker texture is now derived from landmark ID, allowing for more flexible marker texturing.
* Renderers for new landmark components like lore (in [Surveystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/surveystones)) and chunks (in [Surveyalot](https://modrinth.com/project/surveyalot))
* Refactor rendering to share code between the screen atlas and handheld atlas, improving consistency.
* stay in delete mode when holding shift by ([PR by @justliliandev](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/233))
* config to require an item to open the map by ([PR by @cassiancc](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/298))
* Some tile cleanup by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/335))
* Redo lush caves tiles by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/339))
* Optimize assets, again by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/340))
* Update texture credits by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/341))

**API**:
* New API for overlays (e.g. [Antique Trains](https://modrinth.com/mod/antique-trains))
* make buttons easier to use in addons by ([PR by @justliliandev](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/331))

**Fixes**:
* Fix being able to interact with map elements underneath the add marker modal
* Fix resizing the window causing visual glitching with the add marker modal
* Shader support workarounds by ([PR by @NoPyro](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/310 (obsoleted)))
* Add .mcmeta for the taiga village tall house by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/319))
* Fix missing null check on terrainToTileNether by ([PR by @limelier](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/202))
* Fix issues with scaling when mapScale != guiScale. by ([PR by @murphy-slaw](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/273))

**Translations**:
* Update Traditional Chinese (zh_tw.json) by ([PR by @dirtTW](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/204))
* updated Ukrainian translation by ([PR by @Tarteroycc](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/207))
* Update Polish translation by ([PR by @lumiscosity](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/320))
* upd ru_ru.json by ([PR by @prokrams](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/315))
* es_mx Update by ([PR by @TheLegendofSaram](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/285))
* Update es_ar 1.20 by ([PR by @Texaliuz](https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/346))


## What's Changed
* Update texture credits by @lumiscosity in https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/341
* Update es_ar 1.20 by @Texaliuz in https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/pull/346


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sisby-folk/antique-atlas/compare/v3.0.0-rc.2+1.20...v3.0.0+1.20
